correctness.rationale: Reconstructed reset-free velocity convolution with (1-exp(-(t-s)/tau)), exact Gaussian variance 2Dg_tau(t), uniform finite-time angular correction <=v_0*tau and -3tau/2<=g_tau(t)-t<=0. These give positive two-sided multiplicative comparison of excursion MGFs with overdamped Feynman-Kac growth e^{t(Dk^2+Lambda(k))}. Positivity-improving angular semigroup has positive principal eigenfunction coefficient for deterministic and uniform heading, so exponential Poisson age mixture has MGF domain Psi(k)<r, with divergence exactly at equality. Lambda even, convex, nonnegative, and Psi strictly increasing for positive k yields unique root. A tilted exponential concentration at k_star and integrating ages t~x/Psi'(k_star) supplies both log-tail lower bounds; Markov supplies upper bounds. Perturbative Lambda(k)=v_0^2 k^2/(2D_r)+O(k^4), Lambda<=v_0|k|, and exact exponential-age integration give both k_star endpoints and 4D/(tau^2 r^3). Our independent 37-mode Fourier matrices recover two roots and exact thermal renewal identities at six (r,tau) points. Finite matrix checks are not the infinite proof.
residual_risks: No pointwise density prefactor or radial-displacement law established.

value.rationale: Exact far-tail localization versus r^-3 core-width is a motivated distinction for interpreting rare active-particle excursions. The principal Mathieu root characterizes all positive reset rates, not only a numerical special value; its independence of finite inertia is a nontrivial stable structural property. The result is limited to complete Poisson resetting and coordinate logarithmic tails.
residual_risks: No density prefactor, multidimensional radial tail or partial-resetting extension.

final_claim: For D,D_r,v_0,tau,r>0 with complete position-velocity resets and fixed or refreshed-uniform heading, stationary coordinate moments exist precisely for |k|<k_star, defined by D k_star^2+lambda_max(D_r d_theta^2+k_star v_0 cos(theta))=r; log-tail rates on both sides are -k_star for every tau>0. High-rate variance is 4D/(tau^2 r^3)+O(r^-4) and tail-scale/width ratio is asymptotic tau*r/2.
limitations: Positive D,D_r,v0,tau,r and full resets only; only logarithmic coordinate tails, not prefactors.
